Thanks for taking the call last week. Attached is BrightWave's updated security questionnaire (SSQ) — we've added a short matrix section focused on role-based data views and the level of PII exposure per role.

Our security team would like answers to the following by EOD Thursday so we can move forward with procurement:
- Confirmation which Redwood roles can access raw PII (names, email addresses, transcripts).
- Whether we can create a read-only, redacted view for billing/usage reporting.
- Subprocessor list and cross-border transfer controls for EU-origin data.
- A short dataflow diagram showing where PII is persisted and where ephemeral caches are used.

I attached BrightWave_SSQ_v3.xlsx with the items highlighted. Can your team return the filled spreadsheet and any supporting artifacts (diagram, role matrix)?

Appreciate it — Tanya

Jordan / Karthik — forwarding the SSQ with notes. High level: the current DPA already lists our primary subprocessors (cloud provider, KMS vendor, telemetry processor). For BrightWave:

- We should confirm whether they require a Data Processing Addendum signature (most do). If so, Legal prefers to use our standard DPA; deviations require VP approval.
- Cross-border transfers: we have SCCs in place with our cloud provider and provide EU region hosting; we'll call that out and include the specific subprocessor list with country locations.
- KMS: we use customer-managed keys for Private deployments; for hosted API we hold keys in a KMS provider but can provide attestations.

Karthik — can you produce a 1-page dataflow (PNG) that clearly marks: ingest -> ephemeral KV cache on GPU nodes -> optional persistent storage (S3) -> telemetry/metrics (redacted) and which components see unredacted vs hashed values? Attach to the completed SSQ.

Marissa

Hi Tanya — attaching the completed SSQ and our artifacts. Summary answers below and files attached: redwood-role-view-matrix.pdf, redwood-dataflow-v2.png, and the filled BrightWave_SSQ_v3.xlsx. (See Drive link in headers for the source diagrams.)

Summary (top-line):
- Raw PII access: Engineering SREs and Platform Engineers can access unredacted data only in ephemeral caches during troubleshooting; persistent storage is restricted to the Storage team and is encrypted at rest. Support and billing teams receive redacted or pseudonymized views unless a customer requests expanded access under an approved MA/SoW.
- Read-only redacted view: Yes — we provide a read-only reporting view that contains pseudonymized IDs; this view can include hashed emails (SHA-256) or customer-provided token IDs. We will document the chosen approach in the SSQ.
- Subprocessors & transfers: Attached is our current subprocessor list and country locations. For EU-origin data we offer EU-hosted storage and SCCs with our cloud provider; we will note that KMS custody varies by deployment (customer-managed keys available for Private).
- Dataflow and caches: The attached PNG marks where ephemeral KV caches exist on GPU nodes (ephemeral, TTL-based), where we persist artifacts to object storage, and which telemetry paths carry only hashed or aggregated metrics.

Attached artifacts:
- BrightWave_SSQ_v3_filled.xlsx (answers inline)
- redwood-role-view-matrix.pdf (table that maps Redwood roles to attribute visibility)
- redwood-dataflow-v2.png (annotated diagram)

Next steps: If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute walk-through with Karthik to step through the diagram and confirm redaction semantics.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
